lines.text: God says that if a land sins unfaithfully, He will cut off its supply of food and send famine.
God says that if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in that land, their righteousness could deliver only themselves.
If God sent wild beasts through the land, the three men could not deliver their own sons or daughters.
God says that if He sent a flood into the land, the three men could deliver only themselves.
God says He will send four dire judgments against Babylon, yet some survivors will be brought out.
